summary: 闭环补齐 2026-10-04 周更：新增 TOAST、ProAct、ForeAct3D 三篇正文级深读，结构化 LIBERO/LIBERO-Plus/CALVIN 主表，并将旧“最新论文必须停在9月”的回归改为未来增长安全不变量；DSD、Vela 等保持 deferred。

tracks.name: TOAST v1 · LIBERO training-data scale paper table
tracks.split: Spatial / Object / Goal / Long; aggregate reported across suites
tracks.protocol: For every training-data fraction, evaluation is fixed: 500 rollouts per suite (50/task), 2,000 rollouts per seed, three independently trained seeds; columns differ only in policy training-data fraction.
tracks.trainingRegime: PaliGemma-3B autoregressive VLA; identical subsets/settings per fraction across tokenizer methods; columns 1/1..1/16 are training-data fractions, not distinct evaluation settings.

tracks.name: ProAct v1 · standard LIBERO four-suite table
tracks.protocol: Standard LIBERO evaluation following pi0.5; 500 rollouts per suite. Paper-table rows retain heterogeneous pretraining/backbone differences.
tracks.trainingRegime: Reporting-paper comparison; ProAct uses proposal/world/action experts over a flow-based VLA while baselines have different pretraining and architectures.

tracks.name: ProAct v1 · LIBERO-Plus seven perturbation dimensions
tracks.split: Camera / Robot / Language / Light / Background / Noise / Layout
tracks.protocol: Seven LIBERO-Plus perturbation dimensions reported in the same paper; Total is the paper-reported aggregate. This is not standard LIBERO.
tracks.trainingRegime: Reporting-paper comparison with heterogeneous model/pretraining backgrounds; no VLA-Radar fairness normalization.

tracks.name: ForeAct3D v1 · one model for all LIBERO suites
tracks.protocol: One policy is trained/evaluated across all four LIBERO suites; kept separate from one-model-per-suite rows in the source table.
tracks.trainingRegime: ForeAct3D and StarVLA-OFT base share the reporting paper's one-model-for-all training setup; no robot pretraining is claimed for this comparison.

tracks.name: ForeAct3D v1 · CALVIN ABC→D without robot pretraining
tracks.metric: Average completed tasks in a five-task chain
tracks.protocol: CALVIN ABC→D long-horizon evaluation. The track only keeps the without-robot-pretraining group for the ForeAct3D/base comparison.
tracks.trainingRegime: No robot pretraining group; ForeAct3D and reproduced StarVLA-OFT share the reporting-paper training configuration.
